scripts.deploy: echo 'Push to GitHub → Settings → Pages → main branch'
scripts.syntax-check: for f in js/*.js; do node -c "$f" && echo "OK: $f" || echo "FAIL: $f"; done
scripts.db:migrate-001: echo 'Run db/migration-001-init.sql in Supabase SQL Editor'
scripts.db:migrate-002: echo 'Run db/migration-002-rls-hardening.sql in Supabase SQL Editor'
scripts.db:migrate-003: echo 'Run db/migration-003-fixes.sql in Supabase SQL Editor'
scripts.db:migrate-004: echo 'Run db/migration-004-fix-search-path.sql in Supabase SQL Editor — REQUIRED after 003'
scripts.db:migrate-005: echo 'Run db/migration-005-unlike-rpc.sql in Supabase SQL Editor — enables unlike sync'
scripts.db:migrate-006: echo 'Run db/migration-006-comment-moderation.sql in Supabase SQL Editor — comment deletion tokens + roles + soft delete'
scripts.db:migrate-007: echo 'Run db/migration-007-rate-limit-v2.sql in Supabase SQL Editor — tiered rate limiting'
scripts.db:migrate-008: echo 'Run db/migration-008-tags-bookmarks.sql in Supabase SQL Editor — tags + bookmarks + collections'
scripts.db:migrate-009: echo 'Run db/migration-009-storage-bucket.sql in Supabase SQL Editor — Storage bucket for uploads'
scripts.db:migrate-010: echo 'Run db/migration-010-fix-quota-name-type.sql in Supabase SQL Editor — fix check_daily_quota (uuid,name) error'
scripts.db:migrate-011: echo 'Run db/migration-011-comment-replies.sql in Supabase SQL Editor — comment parent_id for replies'
scripts.db:migrate-012: echo 'Run db/migration-012-content-reports.sql in Supabase SQL Editor — user content report RPC'
scripts.db:migrate-013: echo 'Run db/migration-013-submission-edit.sql in Supabase SQL Editor — submission edit with token/author'
scripts.db:migrate-014: echo 'Run db/migration-014-security-hardening.sql in Supabase SQL Editor — server-side XSS/injection triggers'
scripts.db:migrate-015: echo 'Run db/migration-015-submission-delete-author.sql in Supabase SQL Editor — author_id delete for submissions'
scripts.db:migrate-016: echo 'Run db/migration-016-replica-identity.sql in Supabase SQL Editor'
scripts.db:migrate-018: echo 'Run db/migration-018-dedupe-comments.sql in Supabase SQL Editor'
scripts.db:migrate-019: echo 'Run db/migration-019-deaify-live-content.sql in Supabase SQL Editor'
scripts.db:migrate-020: echo 'Run db/migration-020-forum-tables.sql in Supabase SQL Editor — forum tables only. Chat uses db/migration-023-forum-chat.sql (do NOT run DEPRECATED-migration-020-forum-chat.sql)'
scripts.db:migrate-021: echo 'Run db/migration-021-forum-rls.sql in Supabase SQL Editor'
scripts.db:migrate-022: echo 'Run db/migration-022-forum-realtime.sql in Supabase SQL Editor'
scripts.db:migrate-023: echo 'Run db/migration-023-forum-chat.sql in Supabase SQL Editor'
scripts.db:migrate-024: echo 'Run db/migration-024-import-seed-*.sql in order in Supabase SQL Editor'
scripts.db:migrate-025: echo 'Run db/migration-025-cleanup-test-probe.sql in Supabase SQL Editor'
scripts.db:migrate-027: echo 'Run db/migration-027-profiles-nickname-rls.sql — REQUIRED for forum nickname upsert'
scripts.content:pipeline: node -e "console.log('Source: 论坛内容/二创内容库 → npm run content:build → forum/js/forum-import-data.js → forum pull/seed → Supabase.\nDocs: docs/CONTENT-PIPELINE.md')"
